# Feature: Task Duplication (Copy with Edit)

## Overview
Allow the user to create a copy of an existing task and edit any detail *before* the copy is actually created. A new **Copy** action on each task card opens the task modal pre-filled with the source task's title, description, priority, status, assignee, and project tags. The user can adjust anything and submit to create an independent new task via the standard create flow.

This is a frontend-only feature. It reuses the existing `POST /api/tasks/` create endpoint, so no backend schema, serializer, or migration changes are required.

## User Stories
- As an Admin user, I want to duplicate a task and tweak its details before saving so I don't have to retype repetitive work with slight variations.
- As an Admin user, I want the duplicated task to start as "Copy of <title>" so I can immediately tell it apart from the original.
- As an Admin user, I want the copy to live in the same status column as the source task by default so it appears next to the original.

## Implementation Plan

### UI Components

1. **`TaskCard.jsx`** — add a third card action button:
   - Lucide `Copy` icon (size `14`).
   - Class `btn btn-ghost-sm` (matches Edit button styling, same pattern).
   - `title="Duplicate Task"` and `type="button"`.
   - On click: `e.stopPropagation()` then call the new `onDuplicate(task)` prop.
2. **`App.jsx`** — introduce a modal mode concept (currently only "create" vs "edit" is inferred from `taskToEdit` truthiness):
   - Add `modalMode` state: `null | "create" | "edit" | "duplicate"`.
   - `handleOpenNewTaskModal()` → `modalMode = "create"`, `taskToEdit = null`.
   - `handleOpenEditTaskModal(task)` → `modalMode = "edit"`, `taskToEdit = task`.
   - New `handleOpenDuplicateTaskModal(task)` → `modalMode = "duplicate"`, `taskToEdit = task`.
   - Pass `modalMode` to `<TaskModal>` as a prop.
   - Keep `handleSaveModal` unchanged — it forwards form data to the board's save handler, which already routes to the **create** path when `formData.id` is absent.
3. **`KanbanBoard.jsx`** — accept a new `onDuplicateTask` prop and thread it to `KanbanColumn` as `onDuplicateTask` alongside the existing `onEditTask`.
4. **`KanbanColumn.jsx`** — accept `onDuplicateTask` and pass it to each `TaskCard` as `onDuplicate`.
5. **`TaskModal.jsx`** — support the `duplicate` mode:
   - Prefill `formData` from `taskToEdit` **without** `id` (so the save handler treats it as a new task).
   - Prefix `title` with `"Copy of "` (strip any existing prefix to avoid stacking).
   - Modal title text: `"Duplicate Task"`.
   - Submit button text: `"Create Copy"`.
   - All other fields (description, priority, status, assignee, project_ids) are copied verbatim.

### Data Model (Mock)

No new data structure. The duplicated task payload matches the create path:

```js
// formData emitted by TaskModal in duplicate mode
{
  title: "Copy of Fix drag flicker",
  description: "Original description...",
  priority: "HIGH",
  status: "TODO",
  assignee: 1,
  project_ids: [1, 3],
}
// Note: NO `id` key — this is what routes to the create path in handleSaveTask.
```

### Simulated Backend

Reuses the live `POST /api/tasks/` endpoint already provided by `taskApi.createTask(formData)` (`client/src/services/api.js`). The create flow in `KanbanBoard.handleSaveTask` (create branch, `KanbanBoard.jsx:236-266`) already handles:
- Temporary client id (`Date.now()`), optimistic prepend to state.
- Server reconciliation: temp id replaced with the real created task.
- Offline queue fallback via `enqueue({ method: "POST", url: "/tasks/", ... })`.

No new mock stubs are needed.

### Step-by-Step Implementation

1. **`client/src/components/TaskCard.jsx`**
   - Import `Copy` from `lucide-react`.
   - Add `onDuplicate` to the component destructure.
   - Add the Copy button between Edit and Delete in `.task-card-actions` (so user muscle-memory: Edit, Copy, Delete).
2. **`client/src/components/KanbanColumn.jsx`**
   - Add `onDuplicateTask` to the destructured props and pass `onDuplicate={onDuplicateTask}` to each `TaskCard`.
3. **`client/src/components/KanbanBoard.jsx`**
   - Add `onDuplicateTask` to the component props.
   - Pass `onDuplicateTask={onDuplicateTask}` to each `KanbanColumn` in the `COLUMNS.map`.
4. **`client/src/App.jsx`**
   - Add `const [modalMode, setModalMode] = useState(null)`.
   - Update the three modal-opening handlers to also set `modalMode`.
   - Add a KanbanBoard prop `onDuplicateTask={handleOpenDuplicateTaskModal}`.
   - Pass `modalMode={modalMode}` to `<TaskModal>`.
5. **`client/src/components/TaskModal.jsx`**
   - Add `modalMode` to the props destructure.
   - In the `useEffect` on `taskToEdit`: when `modalMode === "duplicate"`, strip the `id` and prefix the title with `"Copy of "` (guard against double-prefixing).
   - Derive `isEdit = taskToEdit !== null && modalMode !== "duplicate"` and `isDuplicate = modalMode === "duplicate"`.
   - Header title: `isDuplicate ? "Duplicate Task" : isEdit ? "Edit Task" : "Create New Task"`.
   - Submit label: `isDuplicate ? "Create Copy" : isEdit ? "Save Changes" : "Create Task"`.
   - Reset handling (create mode) must also clear any stale mode leftovers when `taskToEdit` is `null`.

### CSS

No new CSS required — the Copy button reuses `.btn-ghost-sm` / `.btn-icon` primitives already styled in `client/src/index.css`. Verify hover/active states visually in both themes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Task cards render a **Copy** action button next to Edit and Delete.
- [ ] Clicking Copy opens the task modal labeled **Duplicate Task** with **Create Copy** as the submit button.
- [ ] The form is pre-filled with the source task's description, priority, status, assignee, and projects.
- [ ] The title starts as `Copy of <original title>` and is editable before saving.
- [ ] Saving creates a brand-new task (new id from backend) — the original task is untouched.
- [ ] The duplicated task can be edited/deleted independently of the original.
- [ ] Rapid repeated duplication creates correct independent copies.
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes with no new Biome errors.

## Dependencies
- **Internal**: None — this feature is independent within this sprint (does not touch drag-and-drop logic).
- **External**: None (lucide-react `Copy` icon is already installed; create endpoint already exists).
